text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being explicitly programmed for every step. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning, using complex networks to analyze large amounts of information. You already use AI every day. It helps recommend movies on streaming sites, filters spam from your email, and powers virtual assistants like Siri or Alexa. As AI improves, it will continue to change how we work, travel, and communicate.
